global_delta: R5 unifies five testable transformations under one control law: preserve identity, completeness, causal uptake and recovery/backaction evidence before optimizing away structure. Networking increases routing opportunity, never truth or authority.

clayresearch.delta: Adopt identity+completeness+causal-closure+backaction as cross-cutting research gates. Treat dual-view live fusion and durability placement as candidates, not infrastructure truth.
clayresearch.counterhypothesis: The combined gate may overconstrain useful optimization and its coordination cost may exceed stale-work savings.
clayresearch.next_test: Rank exact-byte release replay, real mesh replay, reward H1 instrumentation and durability/backaction factorial by information gain without displacing BASE critical path.

frank.delta: Historical reward equivalence is measured causal function, not channel-name preservation. Material invalidators must reach affected Frank research work before next safe effect; Frank still receives no self-Harness authority.
frank.counterhypothesis: Static archaeology undercounts reward use and live coordination adds latency without improving Frank outcomes.
frank.next_test: H1 reward invocation/effect/reentry instrumentation plus one real Frank premise invalidation through the converged mesh lane.

gwt.delta: Reuse delivered->reconstructed/ingested->used/replanned->effect->outcome closure for worker fusion receipts. Receipt durability must preserve causal observability, not merely replay counts.
gwt.counterhypothesis: Receipt stage closure can become bureaucratic correlation rather than causal evidence.
gwt.next_test: Shuffled/irrelevant delta controls and stage-preserving lesions; verify replans change downstream action and durable receipt policy does not erase stage identity.

emergenz.delta: Stronger mesh coupling is an intervention surface, never emergence evidence. Test stale-cascade amplification, overcoupling and topology-view lesions.
emergenz.counterhypothesis: Reconciliation may create synchronized low-diversity behavior and false interrupts even while recall rises.
emergenz.next_test: Lesion ClayGraph and UnifiedDB routing views separately/together and measure recall, diversity, false interruption and recovery.

claycode.delta: V18 candidate success remains blocked on exact-current-byte evidence identity. Do not reopen BASE semantics merely for live fusion; first prove existing typed records can encode route/receipt semantics once parser/IR gates execute.
claycode.counterhypothesis: Current semantic surface may be insufficient for causal predecessor/receipt identity and require a language change.
claycode.next_test: Exact committed-byte Ubuntu WP02 replay first; then minimal parser->canonical IR->type/effect live-fusion record proof.

hyperposition.delta: Preserve TARGETED_DELTA/DENSE_FANOUT/DIGEST_ONLY and disagreement between ClayGraph/UnifiedDB recipient projections as explicit alternatives until cost/completeness arbitration.
hyperposition.counterhypothesis: Keeping multiple route alternatives costs more than immediate conservative broadcast.
hyperposition.next_test: Stress ambiguous dependency spans and compare bounded alternative retention versus direct broadcast on miss-cost and compute.

claygraph.delta: Dependency completeness/projection epoch becomes measured routing state. ClayGraph is one derived view, not authority; independent UnifiedDB view and anti-entropy must reveal stale/missing edges.
claygraph.counterhypothesis: Dual projections share enough ancestry that disagreement detection does not materially improve real recall.
claygraph.next_test: Real work-event replay with injected missing/stale/false edges and independent-view disagreement, measuring permanent misses, false positives and rebuild cost.

unifieddb.delta: Keep raw authoritative event cursor upstream of projections; persist route/ack/replan/repair receipts and identity conflicts. Test observer isolation and transactional/group-commit durability instead of assuming per-record fsync or same-file observation.
unifieddb.counterhypothesis: Receipt/projection persistence amplifies writer contention enough to make a simpler Git/raw-event refresh superior.
unifieddb.next_test: No-observer/same-file/isolated writer-backaction factorial plus strict-per-record vs transaction/group-commit crash/recovery test on current Ubuntu lane.

harness.delta: Converge all candidate tests into reproducible fault matrices: exact-byte release identity, reward functional baseline, dual-view mesh replay, delayed/raw-event reentry, observer backaction and receipt durability. No candidate receives Harness acceptance from simulation/local microfixtures.
harness.counterhypothesis: The integrated test matrix can hide which mechanism caused a failure if run only as one large scenario.
harness.next_test: Keep matched single-factor lesions plus integrated recovery run; record raw rows, metadata and rollback for each.

anti_echo: All branch feedback shares one R5 ancestry and is not independent replication.
